mil7.7.6:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, meghassa pañca angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.7.6:1.2: Yathā mahārāja megho uppannaṃ rajojallaṃ vūpasameti,
mil7.7.6:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena uppannaṃ kilesarajojallaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja meghassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja megho paṭhaviyā uṇhaṃ nibbāpeti,
mil7.7.6:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena mettābhāvanāya sadevako loko nibbāpetabbo.
mil7.7.6:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja meghassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja megho sabbabījāni virūhāpeti,
mil7.7.6:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbasattānaṃ saddhaṃ uppādetvā taṃ saddhābījaṃ tīsu sampattisu ropetabbaṃ, dibbamānusikāsu sampattisu yāva paramatthanibbānasukhasampatti.
mil7.7.6:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja meghassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja megho ututo samuṭṭhahitvā dharaṇitalaruhe tiṇa-rukkha-latā-gumbaosadhi-vanaspatayo parirakkhati,
mil7.7.6:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena yoniso manasikāraṃ nibbattetvā tena yoniso manasikārena samaṇadhammo parirakkhitabbo, yoniso manasikāramūlakā sabbe kusalā dhammā.
mil7.7.6:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja meghassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja megho vassamāno nadī-taḷāka-pokkharaṇiyo kandara-padara-sara-sobbha-udapānāni ca paripūreti udakadhārāhi,
mil7.7.6:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena āgamapariyattiyā dhammamegham-abhivassayitvā adhigamakāmānaṃ mānasaṃ paripūrayitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja meghassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.6:5.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
